verdict.rationale: Docusign publishes a public GitHub repo of OpenAPI/Swagger specifications for its eSignature REST API (full swagger file v2.1), explicitly stating these enable machine discovery of capabilities, which directly satisfies the download-a-machine-readable-spec story. However, probes show no openapi.json/swagger.json is hosted at standard developer portal URLs, meaning discovery requires knowing the GitHub repo rather than a well-known endpoint. missing for 10: a directly downloadable spec link on the official developer docs site, no llms.txt, and no independent/community confirmation of ease of finding or using the spec file.
